ui.gap_none: ✅ Amakuru yose arahari, nta mukazo usanzwe.
ui.trans_scan_slots: Igitigiri cya slot zikora isaka ry'inyuma
ui.csv_logic_cols_html: 📄 Inkingi z'amakuru ya CSV: ID(Snowflake ID niba ihari — ntiyikora ku bisanzwe/slot) · Timestamp(isaha yagutse ku masaha 6) · Content(ibikubiye mu pattern/ikintu)
ui.tz_milestone_guide: Igihe n'ukuntu bihinduka (UTC{tz_str}): Agashushanyo kahindura isaha; guhindura UTC bishobora kwimura umucuruzi ku musi w'imbere canke w'inyuma.
ui.time_machine_guide: 🕰️ Imashini y'igihe: Hindura iminsi inyuma canke imbere kugira ngo urabe amakuru ya kera cyangwa y'ejo hazaza, ugereranye amateka. Ni ukureba gusa; amakuru ntakorwaho.
ui.tz_rule_first: 04:00 VN base: irahitamwo amakuru y'ukuri, iragenzura uko phase itemba & k*119 + p*j (j ∈ ±6, ±12) / k*119 + jitter kuri k, p; ku vyuho 16 / 116 / 132 cgeli umuzingi 1072 ikoresha k*116 + p*16 kuri k, p kugira ihuze phase, yuzuza ivyuho imbere niba vyabuze.
ui.tz_rule_mid: Bisanzwe bikoresha umudiho 119 (k*119 + jitter); igihe ikinya ari 16 / 116 / 132 cgeli gushikira umuzingi 1072 (akarorero k'intambwe 14), ikoresha k*116 + p*16 kuri k, p kugira yinjire muri Phase A ihuye (A4 / A3).
ui.tz_rule_last: Izunguruka n'umudiho 119 (k*119 + jitter); ku vyuho 16 / 116 / 132 cgeli umuzingi 1072 (k*116 + p*16 kuri k, p), iraha agaciro phase yahinduwe A2 / C7 kandi igasubira inyuma iyo amakuru yabuze.

default_baseline_summary: Mu gukoresha ibisabwa vy'ibanze: Porogaramu irondera ibiri mu GIS canke ahandi hose bishasha; niba nta murongo w'intandaro uhari canke udashobora kuboneka, isubira ku mpera za CSV ziri muri telefone cyangwa mudasobwa, igahuza amasaha n'uturere, kandi igakuraho ibisigarira vy'insigarira.
default_loader_summary: Inshamake yo kumenyekanisha amakuru: Ironda dosiye za CSV zemewe, igenzura niba hari ibishasha, ikomatanya amakuru, kandi igakuraho ibisigarira imbere y'uko itanga ibiteganywa (ifise ububiko bwihuse bw'ama dosiye kugira ngo yihute).
